easyPrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
description:
Activate Masked Meower by discarding a card and sacrificing it.
When Masked Meower dies, Yedora triggers, returning Masked Meower from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Masked Meower enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Masked Meower by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Masked Meower face-up.
Resolve the Masked Meower ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
